title: mem project current --json
description: The working directory's project, read-only. Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when this directory belongs to no project mem knows; `root` is null when the project was named with --project from outside a checkout. `verify` is present only when the project declared one with `mem project set verify` — its absence means the caller does its own detection.

worktree.description: Present only when `mem project worktree` recorded one on this machine; an orchestrator whose `root` equals it may work on the worktree's own branch.

hygiene_exempt.description: Present only when the project declared globs with `mem project set hygiene-exempt`.

land_ci.description: Present only when the project named, with `mem project set land-ci`, the GitHub Actions workflow file `workflow land` waits on.

device.description: The device recorded with `mem project set device`: mac-mini-m2, nuc or macbook-m2; null when none is.

device_by.description: The machine that wrote `device`; null when no device is set.
